The plate is square, about 20 cm across, so it works as a side plate. The bagel is about 8 cm across and 3 cm thick. A half bagel of that size weighs about 45 g, and a whole bagel is usually 90 to 100 g. The bagel appears to be cut and open-faced, with cream cheese spread on it. I estimate the bagel half at 50 g and the cream cheese at 30 g.
